verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so asking about versioned public APIs and a deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence pack documents neither. 'Versioned forecasts' refers to financial planning data, not API versioning. 'Anything with an API' describes data sources Aleph connects to, not an Aleph API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec at the common paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
